tip.title: Start with your artwork
tip.body: Upload a PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG. Embroidery Studio generates stitches automatically. You can also draw a shape or type a monogram.

tip.title: Your artwork, in stitches
tip.body: The first result is generated when you upload. Adjust colours, size and background in the left panel. Changes regenerate your design; use Generate stitches to run it again.

tip.title: Make it yours
tip.body: Select a shape to edit its stitches or colour. Use the toolbar for shapes and lettering, and the right panel for hoops, layers and threads. This step ticks when the stitches fit the hoop and the quality checks pass.

tip.title: Watch it sew first
tip.body: Press Play, or look at the realistic view. This step ticks when you have done either.

tip.title: Ready for your machine
tip.body: Export a stitch file for your machine or a PNG preview. You can also use Send for Wi-Fi transfer. Save your Embroidery Studio project to keep it editable.
